This figure is from NACA Technical Memorandum 579, Structural Details of German Light Airplanes (1930, scanned).
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
This figure is a composite plate of 21 black-and-white photographs showing structural details of German light airplanes, including fuselage frames, wing ribs, struts, landing gear, engine mounts, cockpits, and complete aircraft.
